title: Dictionary download stage is spread over Progress.cancelled/finished atomics plus DictManager.download, task and failed Options
trigger: Open Appearance > Spelling > Manage dictionaries, switch a language on, then off while it downloads.
effect: Stage (idle, downloading, cancelling, installing, failed) is implied by 3 atomics and 3 Options kept in step by hand; RowInputs.transfer and RowInputs.failed are two Options for one row state.
fix: One enum Download { Idle, Running{code,progress}, Cancelling{code}, Failed{code,msg} } in DictManager, with the worker result as a typed DownloadOutcome (Done, Cancelled, Failed(msg)).

title: finished is set by the caller after the worker returns, so a panicking worker leaves the manager polling forever
trigger: Download a dictionary whose files make spellbook or ureq panic in the background task (malformed upstream data).
effect: Row stays at Downloading n% and the 120 ms poll loop notifies every tick; start_dictionary_download returns early because download is Some, so no dictionary can be downloaded until restart.
fix: Set finished from a drop guard in the worker, or drive the row from the worker's Result (JoinHandle) rather than a flag; clear download on any task end.

title: Cancel is only seen between body chunks, so a stalled server keeps the row Downloading for up to 180 s after the switch is turned off
trigger: Start a download on a flaky connection that stalls mid-body, flip the switch off.
effect: Switch toggles off in the OS-less sense but the row keeps Downloading n% and toggling again does nothing (toggle_dictionary returns early while download.code matches) until the 180 s global timeout.
fix: Add a Cancelling stage that the row shows at once and drop the download future (cancel the ureq call) instead of polling a flag.

title: A cancel pressed after the last chunk is ignored: install still runs and the language is switched on
trigger: Click the switch off right as the second file finishes.
effect: Dictionary is installed and enabled although the user cancelled; Err("Cancelled.") only returned if the flag was set before the install call.
fix: Make Cancelling a stage that the completion arm checks before set_spell_languages.

title: Cancel is recognised by comparing the error text to "Cancelled."
trigger: Any future change to the string in spell_download turns a cancel into a red failure row.
effect: A user cancel shows as a failed download with an error line.
fix: Return an enum DownloadError::{Cancelled, Message(String)} from download_dictionary.

title: remove_dictionary updates the chosen list even when removing the files failed
trigger: Remove a downloaded dictionary whose file is locked or read-only.
effect: Toast says it could not remove, but the language is dropped from the picked list; if that empties the list the engine silently goes to automatic locale languages.
fix: Return early after the error note; only change the chosen list when remove succeeded.

title: A timed-out ISpellChecker check answers correct, and SpellChecker caches that answer
trigger: Type a misspelled word on Windows while the COM thread is busy loading a cold dictionary (over 5 s) or backlogged with jobs.
effect: The word gets no underline and stays unflagged (cached as correct) until the cache is cleared by learn/unlearn/set_app_words or 20k other words.
fix: Backend returns Option<bool> (Unknown on timeout) and SpellChecker caches only Known answers.

title: is_correct inserts a backend answer after a concurrent clear_cache, so a stale verdict outlives a learn/unlearn
trigger: Background re-check is in is_correct (backend call) while the user picks Add to Dictionary on a macOS-system-learned word; the check then inserts its old false.
effect: Word added to the system dictionary stays underlined until another cache clear.
fix: Tag the cache with a generation counter bumped by clear_cache and drop inserts from an older generation.

title: Cache validity against app_words/ignored/backend learned set is kept by calling clear_cache by hand
trigger: Any new mutator of app_words, ignored or backend state that forgets clear_cache serves stale verdicts.
effect: Stale underline or missing underline.
fix: Put the verdict cache inside the same RwLock-guarded struct as app_words/ignored so a write replaces both.

title: recheck_spelling re-asks the backend on the UI thread for every underlined word after the cache was cleared
trigger: On Windows, or on Linux just after an engine rebuild while the warm thread still parses a big dictionary, choose Add to Dictionary or Ignore.
effect: UI thread blocks on the COM thread (up to 5 s per word, CHECK_WAIT) or on the Hunspell OnceLock until the parse ends.
fix: Run the retain on the background executor or only compare against app_words/ignored on the UI thread (no backend call).

title: Heartbeat.beats Option<u64> is both the started flag (None before start and after stop) and the beat counter
trigger: Launch a second Quill before the link loop starts or after it stops.
effect: Owner acknowledges at once because mark/beats None means not running; correct today but the stage lives in an Option.
fix: enum Heartbeat { NotRunning, Running{beats:u64} }.

title: A launch whose sender thread cannot be spawned reports the live owner as not responding
trigger: Start Quill under thread exhaustion while another Quill runs.
effect: spawn_guarded fails, tx drops, recv_timeout gives Disconnected which maps to Forward::Unresponsive; launch shows Quill isn't responding and refuses to start though the owner is fine.
fix: Map Disconnected to Forward::NoOwner-with-error (Unchecked) instead of Unresponsive.

title: A failed first dictionary load is cached forever in OnceLock<Option<..>>
trigger: Dictionary file is briefly unreadable (antivirus lock, being replaced) when the engine first checks a word.
effect: That language's words are never flagged (is_correct returns true when nothing loaded) until the engine is rebuilt by changing languages or restarting.
fix: Entry stage enum Unloaded / Loaded(dict) / Failed(retry after) instead of a permanent None.

title: Each hunspell_engine build starts a warm thread that keeps parsing after the engine was replaced
trigger: Switch spelling languages several times quickly with large dictionaries.
effect: Several threads parse dictionaries nobody uses (the Arc keeps the backend alive) until done; wasted CPU and memory.
fix: Give warm a cancel token owned by the SpellEngine, set on drop.

title: StarPacksState keeps loading, loaded, error and open as separate fields
trigger: Open Stars, press Buy more Stars (maybe_fetch_star_packs sets loading=true, error=None), request fails or its continuation is dropped
effect: loading/loaded/error can combine (loading+error, loaded+error); a lost answer leaves loading=true with no retry for the session
fix: Replace loading/loaded/error/options with Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> (src/state/fetch.rs); keep open as a UI flag in OnScreen.

title: StarsGiftState holds target, options, loading and error as hand-synchronised fields
trigger: Gift Stars dialog: pick a contact (choose_stars_gift_user), go back (clear_target), pick another
effect: Stages (contact list, loading packs for X, packs for X, failed for X) are encoded by Option target + bool loading + Option error + Vec options
fix: enum GiftStage { Contacts, Packs { target, packs: Fetch<Vec<StarPack>> } } so options belong to a target.

title: Star pack answer for one gift recipient is applied under another recipient (answer not matched to what asked)
trigger: Gift Stars: pick contact A (getStarGiftPaymentOptions in flight), press Back, pick contact B (second request); A's answer lands after B's, or Back is pressed and A's answer lands on the contact list
effect: B's checkout page lists the packs fetched for A (apply.rs:274 sets options and loading=false for any GetStarGiftOptions answer; RequestPurpose::GetStarGiftOptions carries no user id); loading=false is cleared by the first answer while B's is still outstanding. Stars are bought for B with A's pack amounts
fix: Carry the target user id in the purpose (GetStarGiftOptions { user_id }) and apply the answer only when stage is Packs for that user; the enum from the IS entry holds the key.

title: New-login review is review_pending counter + review_confirmed + review_error + review_outcome
trigger: Press Yes it is me or No on the new-login banner with several unconfirmed sessions
effect: Stages (idle, reviewing N, failed, done) are spread over four fields; review_confirmed is written by connect/account_hygiene.rs:53 and never read (dead state); busy is review_pending > 0
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing { confirmed, remaining: Vec<RequestId>, error: Option<String> } } with the outcome taken once by the UI.

title: review_pending sticks above zero when a send fails partway through several sessions
trigger: Banner shows 2+ unconfirmed sessions; user presses Yes; send_json fails on a session that is not the last (client closing)
effect: review_unconfirmed_sessions sets review_pending = ids.len(), then on a send failure calls finish_login_review once (decrement 1) and returns Err, so the ids never sent are never answered; review_pending stays >0, the banner buttons stay busy and review_unconfirmed_sessions refuses (InvalidRequest) until the session ends
fix: Set review_pending only to the number of requests actually sent (increment per send), or use the Reviewing { remaining } enum and drop unsent ids on failure.

title: After a partly failed review, retry re-sends confirmSession/terminateSession for sessions already reviewed
trigger: Two unconfirmed sessions; one confirmSession answers ok and the other errors; user presses Yes again
effect: unconfirmed_entries is kept whole on error (only cleared on a fully clean review), so the retry includes the already confirmed session and errors again; the banner keeps the old error text until the next press
fix: Remove an entry when its own request succeeds; keep per-entry result in the Reviewing stage.

title: Terms accept is terms + terms_in_flight + terms_error
trigger: Accept the terms of service
effect: in-flight bool next to an error and the terms option; the ok answer (session_apply_ok.rs:232) is not matched to the terms id that was sent
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Pending(Terms), Accepting { id }, Failed { terms, error } }.

title: The accept answer clears a newer updateTermsOfService that arrived while accepting
trigger: Accept terms A; before the ok answer, the server pushes updateTermsOfService for terms B
effect: session_apply_ok sets terms=None on any AcceptTermsOfService ok, so B is dropped and the user is never asked for it this session
fix: Accepting { id } and clear terms only when the current terms id equals the one accepted.

title: TwofaFlow is code_sent_to options + notice + refetch flag kept in step with PasswordStateOp answers
trigger: Two-step recovery, reset and login-email flows
effect: recovery_code_sent_to / login_email_code_sent_to / notice are cleared in several places (apply_reset_password_result, apply_password_state_op, apply_password_op_ok, ui clear_twofa_flow, connect/auth.rs); refetch is a take-once flag
fix: enum TwofaFlow { Idle, RecoveryCodeSent{to}, LoginEmailCodeSent{to}, Done(notice) } plus a refetch request token.

title: ActiveCall: state, ready, ready_at and the media flags are separate fields
trigger: Any 1:1 call
effect: ready_at: Option<Instant> and ready: Option<ReadyParams> must change with state == Ready; remote_video/remote_screen/remote_audio_muted, muted, camera_on, screen_sharing are intents and reports kept as bools beside the phase
fix: Fold ready params and ready_at into CallState::Ready { params, since }; keep intents in their own struct.

title: CallSummary upload stages are rating_sent, debug_information_sent/error and log_sent/log_error
trigger: Call ends with need_rating / need_debug_information / need_log
effect: Each upload is a bool sent next to an error option (CI-flagged shape); error handlers reset sent=false by hand, rating has no error arm at all
fix: enum Upload { NotNeeded, Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed(String) } used three times, keyed by the request id.

title: A failed call rating is marked sent and the rating card is dismissed
trigger: Rate a call from the end screen while the sendCallRating request fails (flood wait, offline)
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true after the send; the SendCallRating error arm (domains/calls/error.rs) only sets calls.error and never clears rating_sent, so the card is gone and the rating is lost with only a status line; the UI note said Thanks for your feedback because the send itself returned Ok
fix: Upload enum with Sending then Sent on ok or Failed on error, keyed by the request id; show the card again on Failed.

title: Call log and diagnostics answers are applied to whichever summary is current, not the call that asked
trigger: Finish call A with need_log, start upload, end call B quickly before the answer
effect: SendCallLog ok sets log_sent=true (session_apply_ok.rs:523) and SendCallDebugInformation error sets the error on the new summary of call B; B's own upload prompt disappears or shows A's error. RequestPurpose has no call id
fix: Carry call_id in the purposes and apply only when summary.call_id matches.

title: ActiveGroupCall has both need_rejoin: bool and rejoin: GroupCallRejoin for the same stage
trigger: TDLib reports need_rejoin; Quill rejoins on its own
effect: need_rejoin is copied from updateGroupCall (session_calls.rs:579) while rejoin is the driver's enum; readers use either (live_story.rs:397, session_video_chat_caps.rs:60, session_calls.rs:291 read the bool; join_failed/reconnecting read the enum), so they can disagree
fix: Delete need_rejoin; have updateGroupCall call rejoin.want() and let readers use GroupCallRejoin only.

title: Group call screen sharing is screen_share_pending + screen_sharing + screen_share_paused + screen_share_error + screen_share_answer
trigger: Share screen in a video chat
effect: Stage (off, starting, offer built, live, paused, failed) is four bools/options and a String answer; clears are spread over controls.rs, join.rs:470, offers.rs:322, mod.rs:278-284 and calls/error.rs:201,216; readers always test pending || sharing
fix: enum ScreenShare { Off, Starting { request }, Answered(String), Live { paused }, Failed(String) }.

title: Group call transport is transport_ready + transport_error + join_payload (+ stream_mode/stream)
trigger: Join a video chat
effect: bool ready beside an error and a payload string; join failure is derived from transport_error.is_some() || rejoin == GaveUp
fix: enum GroupTransport { NotJoined, Joining { request }, Handshake(payload), Ready, Failed(String) }.

title: join_as_requested is set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never reset on error
trigger: Open an unjoined video chat while the join-as request fails
effect: maybe_fetch_join_as sets join_as_requested=true first (connect/group_calls/join.rs:223); on a send or server error it stays true, so the Join as picker is never offered for this tracked call
fix: join_as: Fetch<Vec<MessageSender>> reset to Idle on error (or Failed) per group_call_id.

title: Chat list ordering sync is chat_order_sync.dirty + deferred + moved plus the driver's batch.open
trigger: Poll batch of updates
effect: begin_update_batch/end_update_batch and ConnectDriver::begin_batch/end_batch each keep an open flag in step by hand; if a batch is begun and never ended (an early return or panic between them) deferred stays true and the chat list never reorders
fix: One enum OrderSync { Live, InBatch { dirty, moved } } owned by the batch; drop the duplicate batch.open.

title: Files handed to Quill are silently dropped past 256 queued or when duplicated
trigger: Send a folder of 300 files to Quill (Send to menu) while Quill is locked or signed out
effect: push_files keeps the first 256 and discards the rest with no note
fix: Return the dropped count and surface a toast when the UI takes the queue.

title: Files chosen for forwarding are taken from the chooser before the chat is known to have opened
trigger: Pick a chat in the Forward to chooser while select_listed_chat does not open it (chat not in the list, filtered or folder-hidden)
effect: choose_start_files_chat does mem::take on choosing, then select_listed_chat; if open_chat_id() != chat it posts a silent Open the chat to attach note and the files are gone, with the chooser closed
fix: Take the files only after open_chat_id() == Some(chat); otherwise keep the chooser open.

title: A failed busy-decline or swap-prompt decline shows 'Could not hang up the call' on the active call
trigger: In a call, a second caller rings and is declined as busy (or the swap prompt's Decline is used); the caller already cancelled so discardCall errors (e.g. 400)
effect: The error banner 'Could not hang up the call' appears on the ongoing call's overlay although nothing about that call failed. All three discardCall senders use the same RequestPurpose::DiscardCall and the arm sets calls.error whenever hang_up does not match
fix: Give the decline discard its own purpose (DeclineCall{call_id}) and set calls.error only for the request that owns HangUp

title: A failed game button press (GetCallbackQueryAnswerGame) gives no feedback
trigger: Press a game button in a bot chat while the bot does not answer (TDLib 502) or offline
effect: Nothing happens: apply_bots_error notes an answer for GetCallbackQueryAnswer and ...WithPassword only, the Game purpose falls to the default arm
fix: Handle the Game purpose in the same arm as the plain callback

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus an error and pending phone/timeout options
trigger: Settings > change number: send code, resend, check
effect: Stage is spread over change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_error, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout; the checks in connect/auth.rs use different guards for each and a lost answer relies on error arm clearing
fix: enum ChangeNumber{Idle,Sending,CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending},Checking{phone},Failed{..}} with the request id inside Sending/Checking

title: 2FA management uses password_state_loading beside password_op_error and password_state
trigger: Open Two-step verification, run get/set/recovery ops
effect: A bool in flight flag shared by every PasswordStateOp request, an error string and the cached state are kept in step by hand
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an op enum holding the request ids in flight

title: One 2FA op's answer or error clears the shared in-flight flag while another op is still in flight
trigger: Start getPasswordState then quickly a setPassword/resend; first one answers
effect: password_state_loading becomes false while the second request is pending; the overlay re-enables submits and a late error overwrites password_op_error
fix: Track in-flight request ids (Vec<RequestId>) and clear loading only when empty; or one Fetch per op

title: my_rights_fetched bool beside my_restriction option
trigger: Open a group chat; own member record arrives
effect: Three states (unknown, not restricted, restricted) are encoded as a bool plus an Option and kept in step by set_my_restriction
fix: enum OwnRestriction{Unknown,None,Restricted(MemberRestriction)}

title: Own admin rights are seven Options set by separate setters next to my_member_status
trigger: Own status changes from administrator to member/creator in a channel
effect: set_member_status resets only my_admin_can_post_messages; the other six my_admin_can_* stay until their own setters run and are only hidden by the match on my_member_status
fix: ChannelMemberStatus::Administrator{rights: AdminRights} so rights exist only for an administrator

title: ConferenceCall::link_open bool and upgrade option track the Add People/share-link stage
trigger: Upgrade a 1:1 call to a conference and pick Share link
effect: link_open, upgrade.share_link and migrated_from are kept consistent by hand
fix: enum ConferenceStage{Upgrading(ConferenceUpgrade),SharingLink,Running}

title: begin_conference overwrites a join in flight, the first answer is then treated as a rejoin
trigger: Double activate Accept on a conference invitation or link before the first groupCallInfo answers
effect: The first answer no longer matches pending_conference (take_if by request id) so accept_conference_joined skips tracking but still queues a fetch and stores a join payload for an untracked call; the second joins normally
fix: Refuse begin_conference while pending_conference is Some (or cancel the old request id explicitly)

title: A ringing conference invitation has no local expiry or way out except TDLib content updates
trigger: Receive an invitation, lose connection or miss the updateMessageContent for was_missed
effect: calls.conference_invite stays Some: ringtone keeps looping, further calls and invitations are declined as busy
fix: Store the ring start and drop the invite on tick after CONFERENCE_INVITE_RING_SECS (manual clock in tests)

title: ConferenceInviteResults keeps pending requests that can never settle if the call goes first
trigger: Add people to a new conference, then leave the conference before all invite answers arrive
effect: is_done never becomes true for a dropped request so invite_results lingers and its toast never shows
fix: Clear invite_results with the conference call, or settle pending as failed when the request is taken

title: Inline query pages are matched by (chat, bot) only, an older response lands on a newer query
trigger: Type an inline query, change the text quickly; the older answer returns last
effect: The picker shows results of the previous query text (acknowledged in the ponytail comment; the UI debounces)
fix: Put a query generation in BotsPurpose::GetInlineQueryResults and compare it with the slot

title: last_callback_answer and last_login_url_info are single slots drained on poll, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Press two inline buttons (or two login buttons) before the poll drains the first answer
effect: The first button's toast, alert or URL is lost; login answer is not matched to the press that asked (login_url_request is also one slot)
fix: Queue answers keyed by request id, or key each by (chat, message, button)

title: game_scores encodes closed/loading/loaded as map presence and Option
trigger: Open and close a game's high-score panel
effect: absent = closed, Some(None) = loading, Some(Some) = loaded; callers insert and remove entries by hand (ui/message_games.rs) and the answer fills only an existing entry
fix: HashMap<(chat,msg), Fetch<Vec<GameHighScore>>> with an explicit Closed removal

title: Create Bot dialog stage is check_pending, creating, created, error and check options
trigger: Create Bot dialog: type username, create
effect: Stage spread over check_pending/creating/created/error/check; BotEditTexts likewise holds load_failed bool beside name/about options and loads vec
fix: enum CreateBot{Editing{check:Fetch<..>},Creating{gen},Created(user),Failed(msg)} and Fetch<(name,about)> for the edit texts

title: 1:1 call stage kept in answered_call, hang_up, second_call and active_call.state together
trigger: Answer, hang up, swap calls
effect: answered_call (Option<i32>) is a 'Pending but answered' flag beside ActiveCall.state; hang_up owns HangingUp beside it; second_call is an enum but depends on hang_up
fix: Put Answered inside CallState / ActiveCall phase so a single enum value holds it

title: Call privacy and recent-calls use a counter, error bools and a clearing bool
trigger: Open Calls settings and the Recent calls tab, Clear all
effect: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error bool; recent_calls_request + recent_calls_error + recent_calls_clearing bool are separate fields with their own clearers
fix: Fetch<..> for privacy and recent calls and a ClearCalls{request} stage

title: Screen share stage is screen_share_pending and screen_sharing bools cleared together
trigger: Start or stop screen sharing in a group call
effect: Two bools plus screen_share_answer are reset by hand in two error arms and elsewhere
fix: enum ScreenShare{Off,Starting,On{answer},Stopping}

title: failed_creates grows when no UI drains it (background account)
trigger: createVideoChat is refused on an account that is not on screen
effect: The request id stays in CallsState::failed_creates until the UI shows it; a switch back shows an old failure
fix: Drop on a timer or hold the failure in the create_join_as/start stage value

title: folder_link_saved is a one-shot bool not tied to the folder or dialog that asked
trigger: Open the share dialog of folder A, create a link, close it, open folder B's share dialog before A's answer; or the answer lands after the dialog was reopened
effect: The answer sets folder_link_saved for any pending folder_id and the next drain flips whichever dialog is open back to the list view and clears busy
fix: Return the saved result as an event carrying the folder id, and apply it only when the open dialog is for that folder

title: Cache eviction of reply-bar fetches drops entries by smallest key, not by age, and a Loaded copy is never refreshed
trigger: Reply to an old message that was fetched with getMessage, then the original is edited (or others evict it)
effect: The bar keeps the stale text of a fetched copy (edits arrive only for rows in a history); eviction can remove another window's target and refetch
fix: Keep fetch order (insertion index) for eviction, and apply updateMessageContent to Loaded copies

title: Previews are matched by URL only and evicted while Asked; more than KEPT composers re-ask
trigger: More than eight composers/windows with distinct links typed at once
effect: An Asked entry is evicted before its answer, the answer is dropped and the chip asks again
fix: Never evict Asked entries, or key the answer by request id

title: Archive settings panel: loading bool + open bool + Option settings kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Settings > Archive; fetch is sent and loading is set only when no cached copy exists; answer or error clears it
effect: Two bools plus an Option stand in for one fetch stage; a dropped answer leaves loading true
fix: Use Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings> for the settings and keep the panel-open flag as a UI (OnScreen) field, not in Session.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog: link, info, error, done and request id are five fields moved together
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields by hand, sets the request id after the send; close_folder_invite resets four again but not folder_invite_request
effect: Stage (checking / checked / adding / done / failed) is implied by which of five fields is set; close leaves the request id set so a late answer still fills info after the dialog closed
fix: One enum FolderInvite { Idle, Checking{link,req}, Checked{link,info}, Adding{..}, Done, Failed{link,reason} } replaced whole on open/close.

title: Folder share one-shot flags and errors: folder_link_saved bool, folder_share_error, folder_limit_hit drained by UI
trigger: A link create/edit or a failure sets a one-shot the UI drains on a poll
effect: Outcome is a bool/Option latch that any dialog can drain, not matched to a folder or request
fix: Push typed outcomes (with folder id) onto a queue like CommunitiesState::outcomes.

title: Folder share error is not matched to the folder or request that failed
trigger: Share Folder dialog open for folder A while a link request for folder B (or a recommended-folders fetch) fails
effect: The error text shows in A's dialog; the dialog for the failed request sees nothing
fix: Carry the folder id (or request id) in the error and show it only to the dialog for that folder.

title: Failed preview fetch overwrites the single preview slot of a different chat
trigger: Hover/peek chat A (getChatHistory out), then peek chat B; B answers, then A's request fails (or A answers late)
effect: The slot now holds A's failure/messages; B's preview finds no data for its chat and shows a spinner or error although it loaded
fix: Key previews by ChatId (HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<..>>) or drop an answer whose chat is not the one currently previewed; fetch_chat_preview_history only dedupes per chat but clears the shared slot.

title: getChatFolder failure gives no feedback when it was asked for the edit dialog or an edit chain
trigger: Edit a folder whose cached spec is stale; getChatFolder fails (offline/flood)
effect: Only the remove-from-folder queue case sets an error; the edit dialog waits on fresh_spec that never arrives (no failed stage), until reopened
fix: Fetch<ChatFolderSpec> per folder id, so Failed is a stage the dialog can show and retry.

title: chat_action_error is one slot overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two chat-list actions (pin, mark unread) fail before the UI drains the note
effect: Only the last error is shown; the first is lost
fix: Queue of notes instead of Option<String>.

title: Page retry: exhausted bool + retry Option per list (main, archive) with a separate folder set
trigger: LoadChats 404 sets chats_exhausted and clears retry; other errors set retry with doubling wait
effect: Paging stage (idle/loading/backoff/exhausted) is spread over chats_exhausted, chats_retry and PendingRequest presence
fix: enum PageStage { More, Backoff{until,wait}, Exhausted } per list; in-flight stays in the request table.

title: Deep-link flow split over deep_link, deep_link_original, deep_link_seq and deep_link_from_agent
trigger: A link opens: start sets four fields; terminal states are reached through six paths (Notice, limit box, web fallback, error, Ui, text); each path must reset original and the agent flag by hand
effect: deep_link=None is set on the wallet-notice and limit-box paths without clearing deep_link_from_agent or deep_link_original; correct only because every start re-sets them
fix: Fold original and from_agent into the DeepLinkState variants (or a DeepLinkFlow struct with a generation) so ending the flow drops all of it.

title: Deep-link stale check ignores states past ResolvingInfo/ResolvingChat
trigger: DeepLinkJoin or CheckInvite fails after the flow already moved to Info/InvitePreview (e.g. the user confirmed a second action)
effect: stale is true so the failure is ignored and the flow stays in its current state without any error while the join request is lost
fix: Match the generation on every DeepLinkState variant that carries one, not only the two resolving ones.

title: setDefaultBackground answer is filed under the current background_set_for_dark, not the theme the request was for
trigger: Set a wallpaper while light, switch the app to dark before the answer lands
effect: default_backgrounds[dark] gets the light wallpaper
fix: Put for_dark in the pending purpose (SetDefaultBackground { for_dark }) and drop the shared field.

title: chat_look_oks u32 counter: the chat colors dialog counts oks to know the save finished
trigger: Save in the chat colors dialog sends 1 to 3 requests; each ok bumps the counter, the dialog compares to the number it sent
effect: Counter is not matched to the dialog or the requests it sent, and an error leaves it short of the target
fix: Track the dialog's own request ids (set of RequestId) and finish when all are answered.

title: Chat photo, theme and background caches are keyed by bare chat id and never pruned (chat_upgrades Vec grows)
trigger: Upgrade many basic groups over a long session
effect: chat_upgrades only grows; stale entries are re-scanned
fix: Drain the pairs once the UI consumed them, or store as map old->new.

title: getLoginUrl answer stored in one slot without matching the request
trigger: Tap two login-url buttons quickly; the first answer arrives after the second request was sent
effect: The open-URL consent for the first button is shown with the second answer, or the second answer is replaced
fix: Key the answer by RequestId or message so each button consumes its own.

title: getBackgroundUrl answer lands in a global slot
trigger: Open the wallpaper preview Share for wallpaper A, close, open B before the answer for A
effect: background_url holds A's link while B's preview is open
fix: Return a Fetch keyed by the preview's request id.

title: A late add-chat-requests page is applied by purpose, not matched to the list generation
trigger: Open the requests list (page 1), scroll to load page 2, refresh (page 1 again) while page 2 is in flight
effect: Page 2's answer appends to the new list and overwrites next_offset with an older offset, so paging repeats or skips
fix: Keep the asking RequestId (or a list generation) in AddChatRequestList and drop other pages, as invite_pages does.

title: Processing one add-chat request while a page is in flight brings the handled request back
trigger: Approve a request while getCommunityAddChatRequests is in flight
effect: The page answer re-inserts the request that was just handled; it stays visible until the next reload
fix: Drop in-flight page requests in drop_add_chat_request as reset_add_chat_requests does, or remember handled chat ids.

title: Community request tracking mixes in-flight table, notification_sends map and outcomes queue
trigger: setCommunityNotificationSettings: settings are parked in notification_sends under the request id; on ok moved into the full info; on error removed
effect: An entry is removed only on ok or error; a request settled another way (take_purpose, dropped continuation) leaves the entry and community_notification_settings keeps showing the unsent value
fix: Store the sent settings inside PendingRequest (or the purpose) so removing the request removes them.

title: Outcomes queue is only drained by the screen; a background account's outcomes pile up and are reported late
trigger: Add a chat to a community in account A, switch to B before the answer; return to A
effect: forget_outcomes clears them on return, so the success/fail toast is lost
fix: Report the outcome as a note on the account on screen at the time, or keep it keyed and drop only stale ones.

title: Boost list page: loading bool + error + request id in BoostsListState
trigger: Open Boosts tab; page request sets loading and request; the reply clears loading, error and request together
effect: Three fields stand for one Fetch stage; the error arm in error.rs must clear them by hand
fix: Fetch<Page> with the request id in the Loading variant.

title: Invite member and join-request pages: loading bool + error + request id
trigger: Open an invite link's details; each page sets and clears the trio
effect: Same trio as boosts; clears only when the answering id matches
fix: Fetch<Page> with request id.

title: Chat-wide join-request pages: a late older answer applies once join_request_latest was removed
trigger: Search join requests (R1 'a'), then 'ab' (R2); R2 answers (latest removed), then R1 answers
effect: is_none_or accepts R1, replacing the list with the older query's results
fix: Keep the latest id until a new query replaces it, or reject ids lower than the last applied one.

title: Admin list answer applied after a membership update dropped the cache
trigger: Open the admin list; getChatAdministrators in flight; updateChatMember arrives (removes admin_lists entry); answer lands
effect: The pre-change list is stored as Loaded and shown until the next membership change
fix: Drop in-flight admin list requests in UpdateChatMember, or tag the fetch with a revision.

title: New join request bumps total_count while a search filter hides it
trigger: Search join requests for 'x' (join_request_queries non-empty); a request from someone else arrives
effect: The request is not inserted but total_count is incremented, so the list count exceeds the shown rows
fix: Bump the total only when the request is inserted or matches the query.

title: Boost chain: boost_intent Option<i64> + boost_slots_by_chat + boost_box phase kept in step
trigger: Press Boost: intent set, slots fetched, boostChat sent; answers clear intent in two places (boost_flow.rs, error.rs)
effect: Stage lives in an Option as a started flag plus a per-chat stash, boost box phase, and note
fix: enum BoostFlow { Idle, FetchingSlots{chat}, Boosting{chat,slots}, Done } owned by the box.

title: A failed searchFileDownloads for disk-paused downloads is never handled, so the once-per-session flag stays set
trigger: Disk gets low and downloads are paused and saved; restart Quill on a healthy disk; the startup searchFileDownloads (SearchDiskPausedDownloads) answers with a TDLib error (or the pending request is settled without an answer).
effect: disk_resume_searched stays true (it is reset only when the synchronous send fails in connect/disk_paused.rs), disk_search_keys stays filled, so the paused downloads are never resumed until the next restart; no error is shown.
fix: Make the search one enum (NotAsked, Asked{request, keys}, Done) and add an error arm in apply_media_error that returns it to NotAsked (or Done) when the request id matches.

title: A failed setChatMemberStatus / setChatMemberTag replaces the loaded administrators list with Failed
trigger: Open the Administrators page (list loaded), remove or restrict a member or set a custom title and the request fails (no rights, flood).
effect: admin_lists[chat] becomes AdminListFetch::Failed, so the page that showed administrators now shows 'Could not update member status' instead of the list, until it is refetched; the mutation error should go only to member_action_error.
fix: Keep the mutation error in member_action_error only (as invite_link_error does for link mutations) and leave admin_lists as Fetch<T>::Ready.

title: GetMoreChatJoinRequests error clears join_request_latest without comparing the request id
trigger: Load more join requests (request A in flight), type a search (request B becomes latest), then A errors.
effect: join_request_latest is removed although B is the newest; B is then accepted only by the is_none_or fallback, and any other older answer would also land. The GetChatJoinRequests arm compares ids; this arm does not.
fix: Remove the entry only when it equals pending.id, as the GetChatJoinRequests arm does.

title: Invite-link, revoked-link and link-count list errors are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Open Invite Links, then create/revoke a link so the list is refetched twice quickly; the older request errors after the newer answered.
effect: The older error inserts Failed over the newer Loaded list (no request id compare), so the panel shows an error with good data hidden.
fix: Store the latest request id with each Fetch (as join_request_latest and InviteLinkMembersState::request do) and apply an error only when it matches.

title: The New Channel type step treats a lost or non-username failed save as success
trigger: Create a channel, in the Type step press Save; a request in saving (e.g. the join-by-request or no-forwards edit) errors, or is dropped without an answer.
effect: new_chat_facts only reads type_failed from info_edit_errors with field == Username and type_pending from requests.get; when all requests are gone and the error is of another field, the dialog advances to Subscribers as if saved.
fix: Record each Save request's outcome (Pending, Done, Failed) in NewChatCreation or the stage and derive the view from that, not from absence of a pending request.

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create several groups/channels in one session.
effect: Every create request id keeps its NewChatCreation (photo, outcome, flags) for the life of the session; no remover exists outside tests.
fix: Remove the creation when the dialog's stage leaves Creating (or when the outcome is consumed).

title: revoke_public_link can leave a half-sent revoke with no PublicLinkRevoke to settle it
trigger: In the public-links limit box press Revoke; setSupergroupUsername goes out, then the second send (disableAllSupergroupUsernames) fails.
effect: The function returns the error before group_type.revoke is set, so the first request's ok is unmatched: public_chats is not refreshed, the box still lists the chat as public although its link is gone, and the limit stays marked reached.
fix: Set revoke with the first request id before the second send and let a failed send settle it as failed.

title: Username check is spread over check_generation, check_pending, check and check_failed
trigger: Typing a link in the Type box.
effect: Four fields kept in step by hand; the box derives 'Checking...', verdict and failed from them by text compare.
fix: One enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation, chat, text}, Verdict(..), Failed{chat, text} }.

title: PublicLinkRevoke keeps requests and a failed bool in step by hand
trigger: Revoke in the limit box.
effect: failed is OR-ed as the two answers come and read when requests is empty; revoke Some/None plus public_chats Fetch and limit_box change together in settle_public_link_revoke.
fix: Enum Revoke { Waiting{chat, left: Vec<RequestId>, failed: bool-free via Outcome} } with Ok/Failed per request.

title: OwnershipState::check_in_flight is a bool beside check_error and can_transfer
trigger: Owner leaves/transfers a chat; canTransferOwnership check.
effect: Set true on send, cleared in the error arm, the ok arm and the driver; check_error and can_transfer are cleared by hand.
fix: Use Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>.

title: InviteLinkMembersState and BoostsListState hold loading bool, request id and error together
trigger: Open invite-link members or the boosts list.
effect: The error arm sets loading=false, request=None and error in three writes; loading is redundant with request.is_some().
fix: Replace with a Fetch-like enum carrying the request id (LinkRequestsState already derives loading from request).

title: Member list paging is tracked by four maps kept in step by hand
trigger: Scroll or search the members list.
effect: supergroup_members, supergroup_member_queries, member_more_bases and member_more_failed must change together; a member_more_bases entry for a request that is never answered stays forever.
fix: One MemberList { query, first: RequestId, state: Fetch, more: Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed } per key.

title: The boost chain is split across boost_intent, boost_slots_by_chat and boost_box.phase
trigger: Press Boost: getAvailableChatBoostSlots then boostChat.
effect: boost_intent (global Option<i64>), cached slots and the box phase are advanced by the driver and the error arm separately; only GetBoostSlotsForBoost clears boost_intent on error.
fix: BoostBox owns an enum phase Main|AskingSlots{chat}|Boosting{chat, slot} and the intent goes away.

title: cancel_untracked leaves a Cancelled intent that only an idle update clears
trigger: Cancel a row for a transfer TDLib reports as paused or already idle (another device).
effect: Phase::Cancelled stays until confirm_cancel, which runs only on an active-to-idle update that never comes; is_cancelling stays true and the entry keeps its place in the indexes.
fix: Have cancel_untracked settle at once when the file is not active in FileMap.

title: Disk-low handling uses disk_holds_auto_downloads, disk_room, disk_paused, disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan flags
trigger: Disk goes low then healthy.
effect: disk_holds_auto_downloads is derived from disk state elsewhere (connect/media.rs) and must match disk_room; disk_resume_searched and avatar_rescan are 'once' markers.
fix: One DiskPressure enum (Healthy, Low{room, paused}) and a ResumeSearch enum.

title: AI style editor/lookup stages: style_save + style_edit, outcome None meaning 'running', styles_received bool
trigger: Create/save a style, open an addstyle link, preview an example.
effect: style_save and style_edit change together by hand (wait_for_style_save/forget_style_save); StyleLookup/ExampleAnswer use outcome: Option as an in-flight marker; styles_received is a loaded flag next to styles.
fix: StyleSave { Idle, Saving(RequestId), Answered(..) }, Fetch<..> for lookup and example, Fetch<StyleList> for the list.

title: PendingBotMessage stop stage is can_stop, stopped and stop_failed bools
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming message.
effect: UpdatePendingMessage rebuilds the value from stopped and resets stop_failed=false and can_stop by hand.
fix: enum Stop { Available, Stopping, Stopped, Failed }.

title: Forward progress is an Option plus a Vec plus a last-result Option
trigger: Share a message to several chats at once
effect: First flight in in_flight_forward, the rest in queued_forward_flights, outcome in last_forward; kept in step by hand
fix: One Vec<Forward> where each entry is an enum Sending{request}/Done(result)/Failed, keyed by RequestId.

title: Sponsored report flow is two Options that must change together
trigger: Report a sponsored message, pick an option, or hit a TDLib error
effect: error.rs:266-269 clears both by hand; any other writer that clears one leaves the other
fix: enum SponsoredReport{Idle,Asking{target,flight},Done(outcome)}.

title: Message link answer is result + is_public + error, three one-shot fields
trigger: Share link on a message then another before the UI drains
effect: message_link_public describes message_link_result but is a separate bool; error and result can both be set
fix: One Option<Result<MessageLink,String>> where MessageLink carries is_public.

title: Instant View fallback is a url plus a from-agent bool plus request sets
trigger: Open an Instant View link that 404s, from the agent and from the user
effect: instant_view_fallback_from_agent must describe instant_view_fallback_url; a second failure overwrites the url but the bool is from whichever came last
fix: Store Fallback{url,from_agent} as one Option and key the request table by RequestId to a struct holding url and origin.

title: One-shot error notes are single Option<String> slots overwritten by the next failure
trigger: Two message actions fail (for example resend and delete-by-sender, or two poll option edits) between two UI drains, or a failure lands while the main window is hidden or locked
effect: The first note is replaced and never shown; a lost toast. Writers: error.rs lines 69, 75, 81, 87, 124-143, 188-211 all assign Some(..) over any undrained value
fix: A Notes queue (Vec<Note>) drained whole, or push to the shared toast queue directly.

title: One session-wide slot for message_menu_actions is shared by every window and every consumer, and a failed getMessageProperties has no error arm
trigger: Open a message context menu in a chat window while the main window hovers a shared-media row (shared_media_select.rs) or the media viewer fetches actions; or getMessageProperties fails
effect: The slot holds one (chat,message); the other consumer's fetch overwrites it, the menu falls back to the permissive local guess (allows(local,..) in message_menu_overlay.rs) and may offer Delete/Edit rows TDLib would refuse. On error (error.rs has no GetMessageMenuActions arm) the menu stays on the guess for good
fix: Key actions by (ChatId,MessageId) in a map owned by the consumer (per window) and add a Failed state that hides gated rows.

title: A failed getSharingProtection turns private-chat sharing protection off without the confirm box
trigger: Profile menu of a private chat: Enable Sharing, while getMessageProperties fails (offline blip, TDLib error)
effect: The error arm sets private_sharing.enable = TurnOff(chat_id) unconditionally, so the driver proceeds to turn protection off; if the other person protects the chat TDLib sends them a request the user never confirmed (AskToRequest is skipped). Also not checked that the flow is still for chat_id
fix: On error go to a Failed/Unknown stage that shows the Send Request? box (or an error), never to TurnOff.

title: AI composer answer is matched only by chat id, not by draft, topic or request
trigger: Ask AI to fix text in a forum chat topic A, switch to topic B of the same chat (or type more text), the answer arrives
effect: window_upkeep.rs:229-246 applies the answer to the composer of open_chat==chat_id and set_composer_markup replaces the whole draft: it overwrites topic B's draft or text typed after the request. A second answer overwrites the first undrained slot
fix: Carry (RequestId, DraftKey incl. topic, draft revision) in the answer and apply only when the composer still shows that key and revision.

title: Bank card lookup answer is applied to whichever card is current
trigger: Tap card number A, then card number B before A answers (request_bank_card_info replaces bank_card)
effect: apply.rs:17-24 only checks the purpose, so A's info lands in B's lookup; entity_links.rs:486-495 compares only lookup.number == the tapped number, so B's popup shows A's issuer title and open-URL actions (a different bank's links). Error arm error.rs:56-61 also clears B's loading
fix: Store the RequestId in the lookup (Fetch<info> enum Loading{request}/Ready/Failed) and apply only on a match, as GiftCodeLookup does.

title: Collectible lookup answer and error are not matched to the lookup that asked
trigger: Tap collectible username A, then username B before A answers (request_collectible_info only suppresses the same entity)
effect: A's info (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND from error.rs:64-72) lands in B's lookup: B shows A's owner/price, or B is marked failed while still loading; lookup.failed is never cleared when info arrives, so a late error plus a good answer shows both
fix: enum Collectible{Loading{request},Ready(info),Failed(reason)} and compare the request id.

title: Receipt answer reopens a closed receipt dialog and is not matched to the invoice that asked
trigger: View receipt, press Esc before it arrives (receipt_open=false, receipt=None), or tap View receipt on invoice A then B
effect: apply.rs:163-166 sets receipt and receipt_open=true for any GetPaymentReceipt answer: the dialog pops back open after the user dismissed it, and A's receipt can show for B until B's answer replaces it. receipt_error (error.rs:44) is also unmatched
fix: enum Receipt{Closed,Loading{request,invoice},Open(data),Failed}; answers apply only to Loading with the same request.

title: Closing the checkout while sendPaymentForm is in flight leaves the payment's outcome unreported
trigger: Press Pay on a non-paid-media invoice (Stars or card) and close the checkout before TDLib answers
effect: close_checkout (checkout.rs) clears request, so shows(invoice) is false: apply.rs:75-98 sets nothing for success, and error.rs:37-43 sets no note for failure; note_paid_media_unlocked only reports paid media. Money may be spent (or refused) with no toast or note
fix: A PaymentInFlight outcome that is always pushed to the status-note queue when the checkout is not showing it.

title: Checkout stage is form_loading + form_paid + verification_started + note + two request ids
trigger: Any checkout flow: open, validate order info, pay, 3-D Secure, close
effect: form_loading is set true by the driver and cleared in apply.rs:43, error.rs:24,31 and checkout.rs:13; form_paid and verification_started are cleared in different places; note is both error and success text
fix: enum Checkout{Closed,LoadingForm{request},Form{..},Validating{request},Paying{..},Paid,Verifying,Failed(note)}.

title: Star subscriptions dialog: loading, mutating, stale, error and offset as separate fields
trigger: Open Subscriptions, cancel one, scroll for the next page
effect: star_subscriptions_loading/mutating/stale/error/offset/subscriptions_open change in connect/payments.rs and apply.rs/error.rs by hand
fix: Fetch<Subscriptions> with a Mutating{id} sub-state and a stale marker inside Ready.

title: Subscription page answers are not matched to a request; a refresh can run beside a next-page fetch
trigger: Scroll to load more subscriptions, then cancel a subscription (stale=true, refresh_star_subscriptions_if_stale sends a second page(false) without checking loading)
effect: Two getStarSubscriptions in flight; the first answer clears star_subscriptions_loading while the second is still out and the spinner/guard drop, a stale append can extend the list the refresh then replaces
fix: Track the in-flight RequestId in the Fetch state and ignore other answers.

title: Errors for star transactions and received gifts are not matched to the live request (answers are)
trigger: Switch the Stars/gifts tab or filter while the previous page request is in flight and let the old one fail
effect: apply.rs:198 and :237 drop stale answers by tx_request/gifts_request, but error.rs:126-137 sets tx_loading=false and tx_error / gifts_loading=false and gifts_error for any failure, so a stale error ends the newer request's spinner and shows an error over a list that then loads
fix: Compare pending.id with hub.tx_request/gifts_request in the error arm, or hold the id in a Fetch enum.

title: Gift code box: loading, applying, applied, error and two request ids
trigger: Open t.me/giftcode/.. link, Apply, error, retry
effect: loading/applying/applied/error/info are set together by apply_gift_code_info/ok/error; applying and apply both encode the same stage; error can coexist with info
fix: enum GiftCode{Checking{request},Ready(info),Applying{request,info},Applied,Failed(reason)}.

title: Giveaway lookup and options keep loading bools beside error fields
trigger: Open About this giveaway; open the new-giveaway form
effect: GiveawayInfoLookup.loading/error/info, GiveawayOptions.premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error (both can be set); option answers are matched only by purpose (apply.rs 136,150) so a stale reply from a reopened form lands
fix: Fetch<T> per list with the request id; GiveawayLaunch is already the right shape.

title: One gift_mutating bool is the lock for ten different gift operations, plus export_unlocked beside TransferStage
trigger: Pin, transfer, upgrade, sell, set resale price, delete, collection edit
effect: gift_mutating is set by connect/gift_manage.rs and premium_hub.rs and cleared by every ok/error arm (lines 49, 109, 115, 138, 144, 191, 325, 346) regardless of which operation answered; manage.export_unlocked, deleting, collections_loading, collections_stale are further flags kept in step with flow/stage
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle,Busy{request,kind}} and clear only on the matching request id; fold export_unlocked into TransferStage.

title: Transfer/upgrade/price/delete ok handlers act on whatever flow is open now, not the flow that asked
trigger: Start transferring gift A, close the picker is blocked while exporting but a different flow (collection edit) can be open when the ok for an earlier mutation lands
effect: apply_gift_manage_ok sets manage.flow = None and reads manage.transfer() for the Gift transferred toast without matching a request id (lines 46-52, 113-141): it closes an unrelated open flow and can name the wrong recipient/gift
fix: Store the RequestId in the flow stage and apply the ok only when it matches.

title: Gift export url, temp-password and error answers are matched by stage only, not by request
trigger: Send via Blockchain: submit password, cancel/close the flow, reopen for another gift and submit again while the first answer is late
effect: apply_gift_export_url/temp_password/apply_gift_export_error check only TransferPicker::exporting(): the first export's Fragment URL is opened and the second picker is closed (flow=None), or its error is shown under the second password field. Gram withdrawal (grams.rs:78) matches by id; this path does not
fix: Put the RequestId in TransferStage::Password{sending: Option<RequestId>} and match it.

title: Resale-search, craft-candidates and auction errors are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Change sort/filter in the resale list (or reopen the craft box) while a page is in flight and the old request fails
effect: SearchResale error marks every loading search failed (lines 257-267), GiftsForCrafting error clears candidates_loading/loaded of the current craft box (296-301), AuctionState error clears auction_loading (284-287): the newer request's spinner ends and an error shows, while its answer is matched correctly by request_id on success
fix: Compare the failed request id with search.request_id / craft.candidates_request / auction_request in the error arm.

title: Gift market: auction_loading + auction_ready + auction_request, crafting + candidates_loading/loaded, search loading/loaded/error
trigger: Open an auction, the craft box and the resale list
effect: Each pair/triple is set in connect code and cleared in apply/error arms by hand (lines 56-59, 109-110, 141, 163, 262-265)
fix: Fetch<T>{request} per list and a Craft{Idle,Crafting{request},Done(result)} enum.

title: Affiliate join/revoke/setup use bools and a counter as stages
trigger: Join an affiliate program, choose recipient, end a program
effect: JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending, earn.recipients_loading (u8 counter, 2 means two lists out) with earn.pending_join (a parked box), earn.setup_closed (one-shot flag the UI drains) are set and cleared across earn.rs:181,257,407,514-523 and connect/earn.rs
fix: enum Join{Idle,Resolving{request},Choosing,Joining{request}} and Recipients{Idle,Loading{chats,bots},Ready(list)}.

title: Program lists and history pages are applied by peer/filter, with no request id or sort in the key
trigger: Change Sort by in the programs list (join.found reset, new page-0 fetch) while the old sort's page is in flight, or reload ton history while a next page is out
effect: SearchPrograms/ConnectedPrograms/TonTransactions/StarTransactions answers (lines 93-157, 41) are applied to the current list whenever it exists: the old sort's first page is shown as Ready (PageLoad::Ready) while the new one is out, and a stale append duplicates rows; fixed only by the newer answer arriving last
fix: PageLoad::Loading{request} and compare the answer's request id.

title: Late Connected answers open boxes the user already left
trigger: Tap a program (getConnectedAffiliateProgram, resolving), go back or tap another program, then the answer arrives
effect: ConnectedProgram answer (166-176) and its error (505-512) call open_join_box_after_resolve / set link_box for the program in the answer, replacing the box of the program the user is on now; Connect ok (178-191) sets join_box=None and link_box unconditionally
fix: Keep the resolving request id in a Join stage and drop answers that do not match.

title: Grams hub page uses loading + error + request id
trigger: Switch Grams tabs while a page loads
effect: grams.loading, grams.error, grams.request, balance_nano/revenue Options are managed by hand (apply_page and the error arm); withdraw already uses an enum
fix: Fetch<Page> that carries the request id.

title: state_requested and rates_requested are set before the send and cleared only in the error arm
trigger: Open the Money page when the send fails (closed channel, client closing) or the answer is lost to a dropped continuation
effect: connect/ton_wallet.rs:80-92 sets the flag then uses `?` on send_wallet; a send failure returns early with the flag still true, so later opens never request the wallet state or rates and the page shows no balance until restart. Only TDLib errors reach ton_wallet.rs:130-131 which reset them
fix: Fetch<WalletState>/Fetch<Rates> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) where a send failure returns to Idle.

title: Wallet transaction detail is matched by tx_loading only, not by which transaction was asked
trigger: Tap transaction A, then B before A answers
effect: Single tx_loading bool; A's answer is shown as selected_tx and clears the flag, B's answer is then dropped (apply_ton_wallet line 73), leaving A's details for a tap on B
fix: Loading{request,tx_id} stage and match the request.

title: Public-post search limits are applied without tying them to the query or search generation
trigger: Type query A, then B in Public posts; limits for A answer last
effect: tabs.limits (including current_query_free and star_count) comes from any GetPublicPostSearchLimits answer (lines 100-108) while every message answer is matched by generation; the paid-search gate search_public_posts_paid (connect/search/tabs.rs:140) reads the price from it and the UI shows free/paid for the wrong query
fix: Carry the generation in the limits request and drop answers of an older generation.

title: A refused chat-link delete leaves the row gone and nothing refetches
trigger: Business > Chat Links: delete a link while offline or when TDLib refuses; connect delete_chat_link already dropped the row optimistically.
effect: The link vanishes from the list although it still exists; chat_links_requested stays true so the list is not asked for again until restart/reopen; only a toast-less error line appears.
fix: On the Delete error arm set chat_links_requested = false (or hold chat_links as Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>> and refetch on error) instead of keeping the optimistic removal.

title: A failed older page of in-chat search ends the results silently, no retry
trigger: Open in-chat search with more hits than one page, scroll to load the next page, drop the connection or get a flood error.
effect: next_from_message_id is zeroed so can_load_more is false for good: the list ends at N of M with no error and no Retry until the search is rerun.
fix: Keep the cursor and add a more_failed stage (as global search's SearchTabs::more_failed does) so the page can be retried; make the paging one enum (Idle, Loading, Failed, End).

title: A failed RemoveRecentlyFoundChat / RemoveTopChat does not restore the optimistic removal
trigger: Search > Recent: remove a recent chat or a frequent contact while the request fails.
effect: The row is gone locally and an error line is set, but the server still has it; it reappears only on the next refetch (restart).
fix: Carry the removed row in the purpose (like SetInactiveSessionTtl { previous }) and put it back in the error arm, or refetch the list on error.

title: Blocked-senders pages are not matched to the list they extend
trigger: Open Blocked Users, scroll so page offset N is requested, then unblock someone (SetSenderBlockList drops the data) or reopen so the offset-0 fetch restarts; the old page answers last.
effect: The late page is appended without dedupe to a fresh list, or take_data() finds nothing, leaves the Fetch Idle and the list is lost until reopened; blocked_total is written by any page.
fix: Put a list generation in GetBlockedSenders { offset, generation } and drop answers of an older generation; dedupe on append.

title: Jump-to-date calendar flag lives in the Session and no farewell or chat leave closes it
trigger: Open a chat, open Jump to date, switch account (or leave the chat by another path), switch back.
effect: The session comes back with history_calendar still Some, so the JumpToDate dialog opens again over a chat that is no longer open; picking a day asks getChatMessageByDate for the old chat. date_jump and date_jump_note stay too.
fix: Close it in leave_open_chat (clear history_calendar, date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note) and in SearchUi's Farewell via close_jump_date_ui; better, hold the calendar in the open chat's view value.

title: Message effect badge lookups only cover the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with messages sent with effects in a chat window (not the main window's chat).
effect: message_effect_ids_in_view reads session.open_chat only, so the badge's effect description is not asked for in a chat window; the badge icon stays empty until the main window shows that chat.
fix: Collect effect ids over chats_shown() (all windows' views) instead of open_chat.

title: Set-edit counter and toast are shared by every edit of the set
trigger: Open an owned set, rename it, close the box, reopen it and start a second edit before the first one answers.
effect: The first answer decrements the new view's pending counter, so busy() is false while the second edit is still in flight; two answers also overwrite the single creator_note so one toast is lost.
fix: Hold the edits in flight as a set of RequestIds on the view (answers matched by id) and queue notes.

title: Emoji-set list failure is recorded only for the tab on screen at error time
trigger: Open Emoji Sets (Installed tab), switch to Trending before the installed list answers, let the installed request fail, switch back.
effect: emoji.failed is not set (tab differs) and no request is in flight, so Installed shows an empty loading state with no Retry until the tab is toggled again; emoji_set_request also clears the shared failed flag for unrelated requests.
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> (installed, trending, search) so each list owns its stage.

title: One shared StickerPanel::failed flag is set by 11 unrelated sticker requests
trigger: Open the sticker panel with loaded sets, then fail a favorite add/remove, clear recent, or a search request.
effect: stickers.failed = true turns the loaded panel into the failure state although the shown list is fine; it clears only on the next successful load.
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> stages; a failed mutation reports a note, not the list failure.

title: A mask list answer sent before a mutation can land after it and re-mark the list loaded
trigger: Manage Masks: open (list requested), remove a set; finish_mask_mutation clears installed_loaded, then the earlier getInstalledMaskSets answer arrives.
effect: accept_installed_mask_sets sets installed_loaded = true with the pre-mutation list, so the removed set shows as installed and nothing refetches.
fix: Tag list requests with a mutation generation, or hold installed/archived as Fetch<Vec<_>> invalidated by the mutation.

title: updateLanguagePackStrings for the pack being switched to is dropped
trigger: Switch language; while the new pack's strings are fetched the server pushes a change to that pack.
effect: UpdateStrings compares with state.current (the old pack) and returns, so the fetched snapshot misses that change until the next full reload.
fix: Also match switching.info.id and queue the patch on the switch, applying it when the switch becomes ready.

title: Settings fetch stages kept as paired loading bools and Option caches
trigger: n/a (stage held by hand)
effect: Each cleared only on its answer or error arm in error.rs/apply.rs; today all arms clear them.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (storage_stats, account_ttl, connected_websites, default_auto_delete); one SettingsOp enum for the mutating ops. data_storage_error is also one slot shared by four requests.

title: Sessions list: sessions_mutating, sessions_stale, device_login_result beside Fetch
trigger: n/a
effect: sessions_mutating/websites_mutating/account_mutating are cleared in separate ok (session_apply_ok.rs) and error (error.rs) arms; stale flags drive refetch on ingest.
fix: An enum for the one mutation in flight (Idle, Terminating, Toggling, ...) and Fetch::stale for the refetch need.

title: Read-date privacy: loading bool, error bool and Option value kept in step
trigger: n/a
effect: SetReadDatePrivacy error sets error=true, loading=false and drops the value; nothing else clears error but the next send.
fix: Fetch<bool> for read_date.

title: Language switch: packs_loading, switching{pack,base Options} and four one-shot fields
trigger: n/a
effect: A switch is done when both Options are Some; ready/patch/reload/error are one-shots the UI drains by hand.
fix: enum LanguageStage { Idle, Fetching{info,gen,pack,base}, Ready(..)} plus Fetch<Vec<Pack>> for packs.

title: Language link lookup: loading bool + info + error + request token
trigger: n/a
effect: take_answer clears request and loading; success/error fill info/error.
fix: Fetch<LanguagePackInfoData> with the request id inside the Loading variant.

title: Business time zones / chat links / bot: *_requested bools, saving counters
trigger: n/a
effect: time_zones_requested, chat_links_requested, connected_bot_requested are set at send and reset in error arms; chat_links_saving is a u32 incremented by sends and decremented by answers.
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>>, Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>>, Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>>; saves as request-id sets.

title: Quick replies: shortcuts_requested bool and messages_requested/messages_failed sets
trigger: n/a
effect: Failed message loads stay in both sets until reopen() drains messages_failed.
fix: Fetch<Vec<..>> for shortcuts and HashMap<i32, Fetch<Vec<QuickReplyMessage>>> for messages.

title: Passkey registration: adding bool, registration, ceremony and added one-shot
trigger: n/a
effect: adding is set in finish_register and cleared by the Add error arm or accept_added; the Parameters error arm leaves registration/ceremony as they were.
fix: enum Registration { Idle, FetchingOptions, Ceremony(opts), Adding, Added }.

title: Date jump stages spread over date_jump, date_jump_pending, date_jump_note and the calendar
trigger: n/a
effect: A jump is resolved in date_jump, then pending in date_jump_pending, then landed; the note is a one-shot; the calendar box is a fourth Option.
fix: enum DateJump { Idle, Calendar(..), Resolving{..}, Loading{..}, Failed(note) } owned by the window's view.

title: Recommended chats: recommended_loading + recommended_loaded
trigger: n/a
effect: Error clears loading only, so the Channels tab is neither loaded nor failed and retries only on the next filter change.
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>>.

title: Sticker set edits: pending counter + refresh_needed + deleted flags
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_sticker_set_edit decrements and sets refresh_needed; accept_sticker_set_view overwrites refresh_needed from busy().
fix: enum SetEditStage { Idle, InFlight(HashSet<RequestId>), NeedsRefresh, Deleted }.

title: Masks panel: open, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, strip_wanted, confirm_remove
trigger: n/a
effect: finish_mask_mutation resets six fields by hand; fail_mask_request sets one shared failed.
fix: Fetch per list and an enum for the confirm box; open belongs to the screen, not the Session.

title: Stickers manager: open flag in the Session plus a commit queue stepped by hand
trigger: n/a
effect: open is set by the UI and cleared by finish_manager/farewell; commits advance only via advance_manager_commit after each answer.
fix: Move open to SettingsUi; model a commit as enum CommitStage { Removing(queue), Reordering, Done }.

title: GIF panel: loading, loaded, failed, stale, search_loading, search_failed bools
trigger: n/a
effect: Error arms set failed/loaded together by hand (GetSavedAnimations sets loading=false, loaded=true, failed=true, stale=false).
fix: Fetch<Vec<Animation>> for saved and for search.

title: Emoji panel: failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, pending_status_emoji, status_note
trigger: n/a
effect: One failed flag shared by three tab lists and the set mutation; error arm sets several fields by hand.
fix: Per-list Fetch and enum EmojiMutation { Idle, Changing(set), Failed }.

title: Profile edit failure is written to a field only the already-closed Edit Profile dialog shows
trigger: Open Edit Profile, change the name or bio, press Save while the request will fail (flood wait, offline). The save handler sends setName/setBio and calls close_edit_profile_dialog at once (ui/profile_edit_save.rs:107-125), then the error answer arrives.
effect: The box closed as if saved with a silent note 'update requested'; the failure lands in users_state.profile_edit_error, which nothing draws any more. The user believes the profile changed.
fix: Keep the dialog in a Saving stage (enum Editing/Saving{request}/Failed) and close it only on the matching ok, or post the error as a note when no dialog is open.

title: A superseded username check's error sets the shared profile_edit_error
trigger: In Edit Profile type a username, then change it before the first checkChatUsername answers; the first one fails (timeout/flood). username_check_pending is matched by request id (line 15-24) so the newer check is kept, but the CheckUsername arm still writes profile_edit_error unconditionally.
effect: 'Profile update failed' is shown under a valid, still-being-checked username and is cleared only by the next check or save.
fix: Apply the CheckUsername error only when the failed request id equals username_check_pending; keep the check outcome as one enum (Idle/Checking{id,text}/Result/Failed).

title: A video userpic's full-info ask is recorded before it is sent and never undone on failure
trigger: Premium user with a video photo is drawn while offline or a send fails: connect/contacts.rs:120 calls take_userpic_full_info_ask (inserts (user,photo)) and then send_json fails, or getUserFullInfo answers with an error (no handler unmarks).
effect: That user's userpic stays a still image for the whole session (state Unknown never asked again) until their photo id changes.
fix: Make the ask a per-photo enum (Asked{request}/Known) and remove the entry on send error or error answer.

title: One failed calendar page ends paging for the box for good
trigger: Open Jump to date on a media tab, scroll to an older month while the getChatMessageCalendar page fails (timeout, flood wait, offline) or the send fails (connect/search/chat_search.rs:437).
effect: fail() sets exhausted = true, so older months show no highlighted days and never page again until the box is reopened.
fix: Model paging as an enum Idle/Loading/Failed{retry}/Exhausted; only a 404-like empty page is Exhausted, a failure stays retryable.

title: Calendar paging stage is loading + exhausted + generation set by hand from the driver
trigger: fetch_calendar_page sets calendar.loading = true after request(); accept/fail clear it; a request whose answer never matches the generation (box reopened, chat changed) leaves loading true for the old box only.
effect: No bug today, but loading, exhausted and the oldest_loaded cursor must change together (accept compares oldest == before to infer exhaustion).
fix: enum CalendarPaging { Idle, Loading{generation}, Exhausted, Failed } with the cursor inside.

title: postStory answer and error are matched by purpose only, not to the composer that posted
trigger: Press Post in the story composer, close it before the answer, open the composer again (ui/story_composer.rs:185-187 resets eligibility, check_error and outcome to None); the first postStory then answers (outcome becomes Posting{id}) or errors (outcome becomes Failed).
effect: The new composer shows 'Posting failed' or Posted/busy for a post it did not make; post_sent clears because outcome left None.
fix: Key StoryPostOutcome by the postStory request id (Posting{request,story_id}) and apply Failed/Succeeded only when it is the current composer's request.

title: Story post flow is eligibility + check_error + outcome (+ UI check_sent/post_sent) kept in step by hand
trigger: canPostStory answer sets eligibility and clears check_error; its error sets check_error and leaves eligibility; getChatsToPostStories error also writes check_error. The UI frame_upkeep treats eligibility.is_some() || check_error.is_some() as 'answered'.
effect: The eligibility answer is not tied to the chat checked (purpose only), and the post-as list error shares the field of the eligibility check.
fix: One enum StoryPostStage { Idle, Checking{chat,request}, Eligible{chat,result}, Ineligible{chat,reason}, Posting{request,story_id}, Posted, Failed } and a separate Fetch for the post-as chats.

title: getChatsToPostStories error is written into the eligibility check_error
trigger: Open the story composer while the Post-as chats request fails and press Post at the same time (check_sent = true).
effect: frame_upkeep reads check_error.is_some() as the eligibility answer, so the composer reports a check failure with the post-as message and stops waiting for the real canPostStory answer, which then clears the line.
fix: Give the post-as list its own Fetch<Vec<i64>> error.

title: A 400 from getStory marks a story expired for the whole session
trigger: A story card or reply header asks getStory before its poster chat is loaded or while the story is not yet accessible; TDLib answers 400. Later the story becomes loadable (chat loads, user joins).
effect: missing holds the key forever (nothing removes it; reset_active_stories_paging clears only story_retry), the prefetch filter skips it and the card says 'This story has expired' until restart unless the story arrives through updateStory.
fix: Enum per story StoryFetch { Unasked, Asked, Waiting{until}, Gone } with a retry for 400 and a clear on new Ready/updateStory.

title: Per-story fetch stage spread over story_retry, reply_attempted, missing and the stories map
trigger: story_fetch_failed removes reply_attempted and writes story_retry; the 400/404 arm inserts missing; success only inserts into stories.
effect: Three sets and a map encode Unasked/Asked/Waiting/Gone/Ready by hand.
fix: HashMap<(chat,story), StoryFetch> enum.

title: ActiveStoriesPaging is exhausted: bool plus retry: Option, mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: failed() sets exhausted and clears retry on 404, otherwise sets retry; apply_stories_ok clears retry only.
effect: The two fields must never both be set; same for custom_emoji_retry plus custom_emoji_failures.
fix: enum Paging { Idle, Loading, Waiting{until,wait}, Exhausted }.

title: setCloseFriends is close_friends plus close_friends_pending applied on ok
trigger: Save close friends: pending ids are staged, ok moves them, error clears pending (error.rs:141-143).
effect: A dropped answer (generation change, sweep) leaves pending set with no owner.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> with a Saving{ids,request} stage.

title: LiveStoryState::extras_requested bool marks that three extra requests were sent
trigger: The viewer sets it when asking streamer, top donors and senders; each answer fills streamer/donors/message_senders independently and errors do nothing (live.rs:402-405).
effect: A failed extras request is never retried while the story is open; the three Options and the flag are separate stages.
fix: Three Fetch<T> fields (or one LiveExtras enum) with Failed->retry.

title: set_donors zeroes committed_stars for any donors snapshot, including one older than the commit
trigger: Tap Stars, commit, and a getLiveStoryTopDonors answer or updateLiveStoryTopDonors that predates the commit lands.
effect: The Stars button total and 'your Stars' drop by the committed amount for a moment until the next donors update counts them.
fix: Keep committed batches with the request that sent them and retire a batch only when a donors snapshot after its answer arrives.

title: createForumTopic drops the cached topic list but forum_row_asked stays set
trigger: Create a topic in a forum that the chat list preloaded (forum_row_asked has the chat). The ForumTopic answer removes forum_topics for the chat.
effect: preload_topics (connect/subsection_tabs.rs:97) never asks again for the chat, so its chat-list row reads loaded = false ('Loading...') until the forum is opened.
fix: Per-forum enum TopicsFetch { Idle, Loading, Ready(list), Failed } so removing the list also leaves Asked.

title: Forum topic list stage is forum_topics + forum_row_asked + forum_topics_failed + topic_load_failed
trigger: forum_row_asked is inserted when the send succeeded, forum_topics_failed on error (never retried: 'rows show No chats and do not ask again'), forum_topics on success removes failed.
effect: Three collections encode Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed per chat; topic_load_failed is the same idea per topic page.
fix: HashMap<ChatId, Fetch<Vec<ForumTopic>>>.

title: Direct messages topic loading is requested + exhausted sets; a failed first load is never asked again
