trigger: maybe_preload_direct_topics inserts requested when the first send succeeded; a non-404 error only sets chat_action_error (threads/error.rs:55).
effect: The first page failing leaves requested set, so the preload never retries; only a scroll to the tabs end calls load_more.
fix: Per-chat enum Idle/Loading/Ready/Exhausted/Failed; clear Asked on error.

title: Saved Messages sublist load is topics_requested + retry_when_online + topics_exhausted
trigger: LoadSavedMessagesTopics error sets topics_requested = false and retry_when_online = true; 404 sets topics_exhausted; common/apply.rs:217 and session_chatlist.rs:198 clear retry_when_online elsewhere.
effect: Three bools changed from four places; a missed reset leaves the pump asking or never asking.
fix: enum SavedTopicsLoad { Idle, Loading, Retry, Exhausted }.

title: Contacts list is contacts: Option + contacts_error: bool
trigger: Invalidation sets contacts = None and error = false (apply.rs:256,273); a getContacts error sets contacts_error = true; success sets both.
effect: Idle, loading, ready and failed are inferred from two fields; a retry has no Loading stage, so a second failing fetch looks identical to the first.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: Three emoji-icon lists each carry a hand-kept *_failed bool; wearable_gifts_loaded conflates answered and failed
trigger: Errors set the *_failed flags (users/error.rs:46-71); connect/* and session_peer_color.rs reset them before a retry; payments/error.rs:132 sets wearable_gifts_loaded = true on a failure.
effect: A failed wearable-gifts request is indistinguishable from an empty list, so the colour editor shows no gifts and no retry hint.
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>> / Fetch<Vec<ReceivedGift>>.

title: New contact box stage is new_contact_request + new_contact_outcome (+ contacts invalidation)
trigger: Create sends importContacts and records the id; the answer writes an outcome keyed by that id only if new_contact_request still equals it; closing the box clears the request.
effect: An outcome written for an open box that is closed before it reads it stays in new_contact_outcome until the next box; the invalidation of contacts runs even when the box is gone.
fix: enum NewContact { Closed, Sending{request}, Done{request,outcome} } owned by the box.

title: History retention stage is spread over closed_chats, release_chats, holds, dropped and the histories map
trigger: A chat moves between shown, queued for release, held, closed tail and dropped through retain/push_back calls in release_chat_history, settle_history_releases, touch_chat and drop_history_entry.
effect: Membership in five collections must stay consistent by hand (history_entry checks three of them before touching the LRU); no bug found, but each new creation path has to remember the same checks.
fix: A per-chat enum Retention { Shown, Releasing, Held, ClosedTail(rank), Dropped(memo) } in one map.

title: AddContact failure has no handler in the users error arm
trigger: Add a contact from a profile while the addContact request fails (flood wait, offline).
effect: RemoveContact/ImportContacts/AddContactByPhone report errors but AddContact falls into the catch-all, so the Add button shows no failure unless a shared handler elsewhere reports it.
fix: Add AddContact to the contacts_notice arm.

title: viewMessages ack is not matched to the request: commit_viewed/abort_viewing act on every id in `viewing` of the chat
trigger: Scroll a busy chat so two viewMessages requests (different ids) are in flight at once. The first answers ok: commit_viewed moves ALL `viewing` ids, including the second request's, into `viewed`. The second then fails (flood, network): abort_viewing finds `viewing` empty, so those ids are never re-sent. Same when an answer from before a chat re-open lands after the new open generation began viewing.
effect: Messages whose view failed stay marked viewed: the chat keeps its unread count/mentions/reactions until the chat is re-opened (viewed is cleared per open generation).
fix: Key the in-flight set by RequestId (and view_generation): `viewing: HashMap<RequestId, BTreeSet<i64>>`; commit/abort only the entry of the answering request and ignore an answer whose view_generation is not current.

title: HistoryState window load stage is loaded_complete + newer_failed + load_failed + newer_exhausted kept in step by hand
trigger: Page far back, fail a newer page, reset the window, trim the window: each path clears a different subset (reset_window clears four, trim_window_end(Newest) clears only newer_failed, trim(Oldest) clears only loaded_complete).
effect: No bug today; every new path must remember which of the four flags it resets.
fix: One `WindowLoad { older: Fetch|Complete, newer: Idle|Failed|Exhausted{latest,newest}, first: Idle|Failed }` enum owned by the window and replaced by reset_window.

title: viewMessages bookkeeping is five collections plus a bool: viewed, viewing, visible, on_screen, visible_reported
trigger: An id moves visible -> viewing -> viewed by hand in begin_viewing/mark_viewed/commit_viewed/abort_viewing/reaction_unread; visible_reported switches which rule picks ids.
effect: See the viewing bug (same file, line 544); the stages of one id are not a value.
fix: `BTreeMap<i64, ViewStage>` with `ViewStage::{Due, InFlight(RequestId), Done}` and an enum for Unreported/Reported.

title: unread_anchor and opened_with_unread are two fields of one 'opened at unread' mode
trigger: Open a chat with unread messages; deleting the bar message clears unread_anchor but not opened_with_unread; jumping to latest clears both via end_unread_open; reset_window clears neither.
effect: No bug found; reset_window leaves a stale anchor by design.
fix: `enum OpenAt { Tail, Unread { anchor: MessageId, bar: Option<MessageId> } }`.

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading: bool next to error and request: Option<RequestId>
trigger: Open a link's member list: loading=true,request=Some; answer sets loading=false,error=None,request=None; error sets loading=false,request=None,error=Some. Three fields change together in four places.
effect: No bug today (answers are matched on `request`); loading and request can disagree if a path forgets one.
fix: `page: Fetch<RequestId>`-style enum: Idle | Loading(RequestId) | Failed(String), members kept beside it.

title: CommonGroupsPaging is two bools (exhausted, loading_more) beside ProfileChatsFetch
trigger: Groups in common: first page sets exhausted from its length; a follow-up sets loading_more; the answer take()s loading_more to decide replace-or-extend.
effect: See the two bugs on this struct.
fix: `enum GroupsPaging { More, Asking(RequestId), End }` stored inside ProfileChatsFetch::Loaded.

title: A failed follow-up page of groups in common ends the list for good
trigger: Open a user's profile with more than 40 common groups, scroll to load the next page while offline / on a FLOOD_WAIT: fail_profile_fetch sets exhausted=true and returns.
effect: The list silently stops after the first page; no Retry row, no later page until the profile is closed and reopened (reopening re-fetches).
fix: Failed follow-up returns to `More` (or a `PageFailed` variant with a retry affordance) instead of End; only a short page is End.

title: loading_more is not tied to the request that set it, so a stale groups-in-common answer is taken as the first page
trigger: Load page 2 (loading_more=true), then trigger fetch_profile_chats for the same user again (retry/reopen) which removes the paging entry; page 2's late answer arrives with loading_more=false and replaces the list.
effect: After the fresh first page landed, the late page-2 answer replaces it: the panel lists only page 2's groups and `exhausted` is recomputed from it.
fix: Carry the RequestId in the Loading/Asking variants (as ProfilePhotosFetch does) and apply an answer only when its id matches.

title: refresh_chat_statistics drops the Loading entry while the old request is still pending and the new fetch is skipped
trigger: Open channel statistics, press Refresh while the first getChatStatistics is still in flight: the entry is removed, fetch_chat_statistics sees has_purpose_for_chat and returns Ok(None) without re-inserting Loading.
effect: The panel shows neither spinner nor data until the old answer lands (then it fills with the old result, ignoring the refresh); if that request is lost it stays empty. Same Loading-without-request-id shape in PollStatsFetch, InviteLinkFetch, JoinRequestFetch, AdminListFetch, ChatEventLogFetch.
fix: Give `Loading` the RequestId (like ProfilePhotosFetch) and have refresh replace it with a new Loading(id) so only that answer applies.

title: A transient getMapThumbnailFile error is remembered as 'asked' for the whole session
trigger: Open a chat with location messages while Telegram answers FLOOD_WAIT/timeout for getMapThumbnailFile: failed() removes `awaiting` but keeps the key in `asked`.
effect: Those places keep the coordinate card with no map tile until Quill restarts or 1024 other places are asked; opening the chat again does not retry. The request is also not sweepable, so a lost one never settles via the sweep either.
fix: Per-place `enum Tile { Asking(RequestId), Ready(FileId), Failed{retry_after} }` in one map; Failed retried after a delay or on reconnect.

title: The 1024-place cap clears `files` and `asked` while the open chat still shows more places than that, so tiles are re-requested in a loop
trigger: Open a chat whose loaded window (up to 1500 messages) holds more than 1024 distinct locations/venues: each expect() at the cap clears the maps, the next pass finds the earlier places unasked and asks again.
effect: Tiles flicker to placeholders and getMapThumbnailFile is re-sent for places already answered, on every poll while the chat is open.
fix: Evict least-recently-shown entries (LRU) or only drop places not in the open window; never wholesale clear.

title: MediaLibrary tracks a set's load stage in three collections: set_stickers, loading, failed
trigger: ensure_library_sets inserts into `loading` after the send; accept/fail move it to set_stickers/failed; open_media_panel and reconnect clear `failed`; creator.rs removes from `failed`.
effect: No stuck state found (lost requests settle through settle_lost_request), but four writers keep three sets consistent by hand, and the MAX_LIBRARY_LOADS cap counts `loading`.
fix: `HashMap<i64, SetLoad>` with `SetLoad::{Loading(RequestId), Ready(Vec<StickerItem>), Failed}`.

title: The reaction picker's options (MessageReactionsState) and payments.paid.offered change together by hand
trigger: accept_message_reaction_options sets both; reset_message_reactions clears both; fetch_message_reactions replaces only the first (Loading) and fail_message_reaction_options only the first.
effect: paid.offered can name message A while the state is for B (harmless today because paid_reaction.rs compares the message ids).
fix: Put `paid_offered: bool` inside MessageReactionOptions and drop payments.paid.offered.

title: Stacked optimistic reactions on one message restore the wrong snapshot when the first is refused
trigger: React with A then quickly B on the same message; set_own_reaction_for records `before` for each. A is refused: settle_own_reaction restores A's pre-image, which also removes B's optimistic reaction.
effect: B's chip disappears until TDLib's updateMessageInteractionInfo for B arrives (self-corrects); if B's request also failed, its snapshot is restored later over newer state.
fix: Undo by reverting only this request's own change (remove the reaction it added) instead of restoring a whole interaction_info snapshot.

title: OwnershipState is check_in_flight/check_error/can_transfer and transfer_in_flight/transfer_error/transferred as loose fields
trigger: begin_ownership_check, accept_can_transfer_ownership and the error arm each set three fields; begin/finish/fail_ownership_transfer set three more; the UI clears transfer_error/transferred by hand when the dialog opens.
effect: No bug found beyond the lost-answer case below; the stages are not a value.
fix: `Fetch<CanTransferOwnershipResult>` for the check and `enum Transfer { Idle, Sending(OwnershipTransfer), Failed(String), Done(OwnershipTransfer) }`.

title: check_in_flight has no request id and CanTransferOwnership is not swept, so a lost answer blocks every later check
trigger: Open the transfer dialog; the canTransferOwnership answer never arrives (connection drop while the request stays registered). Close and reopen the dialog: check_can_transfer_ownership returns early on check_in_flight.
effect: The transfer dialog keeps its checking state; Transfer never becomes available until the account session restarts.
fix: Store `Option<RequestId>` and let a new dialog open replace it; or make the request sweepable.

title: A late isProfileAudio answer overwrites a local save or remove made in the meantime
trigger: Open a song's Save to menu (isProfileAudio sent), tap Save to Profile before the answer; local_save_profile_audio sets the id true, then the check answers 404 and apply_profile_music_error sets it false.
effect: The menu offers Profile again for a track that is saved (or shows Remove for a track just removed) until the next check.
fix: Make the per-song state `Unknown | Asking(RequestId) | Known(bool)` and drop an answer when a local change replaced Asking.

title: Row-progress grading uses only the main window's rows, so auto-download progress in a chat window is always coalesced
trigger: Open a chat in its own window while the main window shows another chat; photos auto-download in the chat window. file_need compares against RowsOnScreen (reported by the main window only) and falls to RedrawNeed::Later.
effect: Download progress and the completing row update in batches instead of live in the chat window (cosmetic).
fix: Report rows per window view (WindowViews) and test the window that draws the chat, as interaction_need does for the chat-window case.

title: updateSupergroupFullInfo and the full-info answer rebuild SupergroupFullInfoData with admin, member_counts, profile and direct_messages_chat_id reset to defaults
trigger: Open a group's manage dialog or permissions box so admin flags (merge_full_admin), restricted/banned counts (session_permissions_box) and the direct-messages chat id (set_direct_messages_chat) are stored; then TDLib sends any updateSupergroupFullInfo (member count change, slow mode, boost) or the info is refetched.
effect: History-visible, hidden-members and sponsored toggles read false, the permissions box rows read 0 restricted/banned, the Gift/location row and the direct-messages link vanish until each side-channel fetch runs again.
fix: Update the existing entry in place (copy only the fields the payload carries) instead of inserting a fresh struct; keep the side-channel parts as separate Fetch<T> values.

title: A created or edited invite link turns an unfetched, Loading or Failed link list into Loaded with one entry
trigger: Create an invite link (CreateChatInviteLink) before the chat's link list was fetched, or while getChatInviteLinks is in flight / failed.
effect: The list is marked Loaded with total_count 1 and the new link only; fetch_chat_invite_links skips Loaded, so the other links never show until a manual refresh. If the list answer lands later it overwrites, if it already failed nothing refetches.
fix: Only merge into a Loaded list; for any other state keep the state and mark the list stale so the fetch runs again.

title: A story album answer creates the chat's album list when albums were never fetched
trigger: Create a story album (CreateStoryAlbum) in a chat whose albums were not loaded.
effect: stories.albums gets an entry with one album, which the album UI reads as the whole list.
fix: Store albums as Fetch<Vec<_>> and merge only into a Ready list.

title: An envelope dropped as out-of-order is dropped before its pending request is taken, so the request and its download count leak
trigger: An answer arrives with seq <= last_seq (reader reorder or seq reset) for a mutation or a DownloadFile request.
effect: The request stays in RequestRegistry.pending forever (only sweepable lookups are swept); for a download has_download() stays true so the file is never asked again, and its spinner never clears.
fix: Take the pending request first and settle it (as lost) when the envelope is ignored, or do not drop answers by seq at all.

title: is_user_action classifies a request by the Debug-name prefix of its purpose (Get/Load/Search/Download/View/Open/Close/SetOnline)
trigger: (1) A user press whose purpose starts with Get/Open/Close (for example getPaymentForm, a close-secret-chat) hits a flood limit: no flood notice. (2) Log out or close: settle_account_requests drops every non-prefixed purpose (Set/Create/Toggle/Send/Edit...) without its failure handler.
effect: Flood notice missing for some user actions; in-flight UI state held by dropped Set*/Create*/Toggle* requests is never settled, and the Session survives a re-login (see session_updates entering Ready), so a spinner or busy marker can stay.
fix: Put a RequestPurpose::kind() (UserAction | Lookup | Auth) on each domain purpose enum, matched exhaustively; settle every non-auth request on logout.

title: Optimistic rollbacks restore the pre-request value unconditionally, except the topic mute and poll vote
trigger: Toggle a supergroup setting or pin a chat, an update (another admin or device) changes the same value, then the first request fails.
effect: The rollback overwrites the newer truth with the old value until the next update.
fix: Store the shown value in every rollback and restore only when the current value still equals it, as ForumTopicMute does.

title: is_sweepable leaves the later-page and tab searches out, so a lost answer keeps their in-flight state
trigger: Open global search, Channels tab or Posts tab, or press Load more; the answer is lost.
effect: Leg stays Pending (panel says Searching), tabs.loading_more or recommended_loading stays true until a new query; Load more is refused.
fix: Give the in-flight state a deadline in one Fetch value or add these purposes to the sweep list.

title: set_search_filters with an empty query changes the tab but keeps the generation and results, so an in-flight answer of the old tab still applies
trigger: Open search on Chats (recents request in flight), switch to Channels or Posts with an empty field.
effect: The Recent chats list lands under the new tab and the panel reads Ready.
fix: Bump the generation and clear results whenever filters change.

title: A failed Saved Messages tag page is recorded as loaded and complete
trigger: Filter Saved Messages by a tag while offline or on a server error.
effect: The filter marks loaded and loaded_complete, so the empty result may read as no messages and paging stops for good.
fix: Make the filter a Fetch with a Failed variant that offers Retry.

title: SearchTabsState holds recommended_loading + recommended_loaded and loading_more + more_failed as separate bools
fix: Fetch<Vec<ChatId>> for the recommendations and a PageState {Idle, Loading, Failed} for the paging.

title: ChatSearchState keeps open, chat_id, status, loading_more and jump in step by hand
trigger: begin_query sets open without chat_id; close/open_for/clear_query each reset a different subset.
fix: One enum Closed | Open{chat, query, stage} with the paging stage inside.

title: TopicHistory paging stage is has_newer + newer_failed + loaded_complete + stale_pages
fix: A per-end PageEnd {More, Loading(id), Failed, Complete}.

title: SearchState open + recents + query + public_limits_exceeded select the surface by hand next to the derived status()
fix: Surface enum Closed | Recents | Query{..} | Browse.

title: SavedMessagesState: topics_requested, topics_exhausted, retry_when_online, tags_loaded are a hand-kept fetch stage
fix: Fetch-like enum for topics and one for tags.

title: SavedTagSearch: loaded + request + history.loaded_complete
fix: Page stage enum Idle | Asking(RequestId) | Done | Failed.

title: PendingBotMessage stop_failed + stopped + can_stop + keep_on_stop
fix: Stop stage enum Running | Stopping | Stopped | StopFailed.

title: RequestRegistry.window is ambient state that must follow the swapped SessionView (enter_view / with_view / apply_payload_in_asking_view)
fix: Pass the window as an argument to register, or hold the view and its window as one value.

title: PendingRequest correlates answers through ~12 optional key fields where the purpose decides which one is read
fix: Move the key into the purpose variant (a typed key per purpose).

title: open_chat + open_topic (+ threads.thread, saved views) are reset together by open_chat and leave_open_chat
fix: One OpenView enum: None | Chat{id, topic: TopicList|Topic|Thread|Saved}.
